snippet.title: The King of Fighters ALLSTAR Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the entire series of ”The King of Fighters“ in this action brawler!

The first of its kind, beat ‘em up action game with all characters from the entire KOF series from KOF '94 to KOF XIV.

Choose from hundreds of original fighters and create the strongest team! All your old favorites are here, but you will find new characters as well!

Game Releases October 22nd
Pre-Register Now!
https://bit.ly/2p4ChVO
